Explicit native R records, finite precomputed statistical arrays and explicit target/coefficient names, with source zero-based indexing in strict scan mode. Arbitrary Python typed dataclasses, pandas object protocols and Matplotlib ax injection remain outside this bounded native language representation.

Frozen Python pandas sorted coefficient-selected full-refit/fixed-covariance bootstrap width ratio as continuous line and identity baseline y=1, source title and axis labels. Native fixtures and opt-in direct Python Matplotlib artist differential tests are committed, exact-head CI execution unobserved.
R numerical-domain validation and error conditions are explicit; Python TypeError, KeyError, IndexError, ValueError classes and general duck typing are not reproduced across runtimes.

Default R base-graphics and invisible numeric auditing values remain unchanged. Strict source mode returns a typed R source scientific artist record including ordered plots, axes text and provenance, not live Python Matplotlib Axes or pixel geometry.
Read-only comparison of supplied full-refit versus fixed-covariance simultaneous bootstrap band widths. No covariance or bootstrap refitting is introduced.
